name: nxt-foundry-site
description: NXT Foundry website, bundled to run offline.

scripts.build:offline: vite build --base ./ --outDir offline --emptyOutDir && node scripts/make-offline.mjs offline
scripts.test:recon: vite build --ssr scripts/recon-check.ts --outDir node_modules/.tmp/recon-check --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.tmp/recon-check/recon-check.js
